caption: The drawing features a collection of outlined and stylized objects rendered on a pale, muted bluish-gray background. There are three stylized birds depicted in bold blue tones: one large, ornate bird with a long, curved tail and leaf-like shapes emerging from its body occupies the central area; a second, smaller bird with a crest and branch-like base sits to the upper right; and a third, smaller bird with decorative body patterns stands on an oval plate with evenly spaced dots toward the bottom center of the drawing. In the upper left corner is a simple, pale turquoise line drawing of a bird with dots along its neck and body. The drawing also includes five container outlines: a simple jug with a narrow neck and handle in the top right, a tall vase or urn shape to the middle right, a similar urn shape to the bottom right, and two square-ish jars with short necks to the left and bottom left. There is also a solid turquoise rectangle near the bottom right corner. The artist’s signature, “CHAS. CASEAU,” appears at the lower right. The composition is arranged with the birds predominantly in darker blue shades and the containers outlined in thin, uncolored lines, contrasting with the subdued background.
title: Bird Decorations on Jug
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
